name: Classic trail mix
tagline: Almonds, cashews, peanuts and raisins: the mix that started every hike.
metaDescription: A balanced everyday trail mix of roasted almonds, salted cashews, honey-roasted peanuts, raisins and sunflower seeds, packed fresh to order.
description: This is the mix we reach for when someone says they just want a proper trail mix and nothing fancy. Dry-roasted almonds bring the crunch, salted roasted cashews add a buttery softness, and honey-roasted peanuts give a sweet, sticky edge that keeps every handful interesting.

Plump raisins and sunflower seeds fill the gaps. The raisins are chewy and sweet, which stops the salt from taking over, and the seeds add a light, nutty snap. We blend the mix by hand in small batches so the ratio stays generous with the nuts instead of the fruit.

It travels well in a jacket pocket, sits happily in a desk drawer, and works as a topping for yoghurt or porridge when you want some texture. If you like to tweak, pour it into a bowl and add a few chocolate chips or dried cherries of your own.
Our guide to building a trail mix explains how we think about the balance of salty, sweet and crunchy, if you want to make your own blend at home.
ingredients: Dry-roasted almonds, salted roasted cashews, honey-roasted peanuts (peanuts, honey, sugar), raisins, sunflower seeds.
mayContain: May contain traces of other tree nuts, sesame and soy.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place in a resealable bag or jar. Best eaten within a couple of months of opening.
